component.name: Spotifast Lossless
component.summary: An unofficial Spotifast fork that plays Spotify Lossless

description.p: An unofficial fork of Spotifast, the native Spotify client by Carmine Paolino. It adds lossless playback through Spotify's own Soloist receiver, and is not made or supported by the Spotifast project.

Choose Lossless in Settings and a guide downloads Soloist from Spotify, stores your own Soloist key in your keyring, and pairs the receiver once in Spotify's app. Spotifast then plays through it and shows the quality Spotify reports. Playback needs Spotify Premium.
Everything else is Spotifast: your library, search, playlists, the queue, lyrics, Spotify Connect, media keys, the visualisers, and a mini player for classic Winamp skins.
